## 🏗️ Project Architecture

### VB.NET Modules (`.NET 9`)

* **EQ12.Core** — Shared utilities, models, logging
* **EQ12.Security** — Encryption, credentials, JWT, authentication
* **EQ12.TelegramBot** — Webhook handler, notifications
* **EQ12.StackAgent** — Job scheduler (Quartz.NET)
* **EQ12.Diagnostics** — System monitoring, Serilog
* **EQ12.CommandCenter** — CLI runner, interactive REPL
* **EQ12.CI** — Build pipeline, code generation

### Python Modules

* **EQ12_2025_MASTER_ORCHESTRATOR.py** — Revenue stream coordinator
* **eq12_bankroll_manager.py** — Bankroll tracking and risk management
* **eq12_2025_dashboard_generator.py** — Real-time HTML dashboard
* **gumroad_sync.py** — Marketplace sales automation
* **analytics_report.py** — Revenue metrics aggregation
* **azure_ml_integration.py** — Model training and inference

### Databases

* **data/business_intelligence.db** — Revenue snapshots, metrics (192+ records)
* **data/copywriting_empire.db** — Content revenue streams (12 configurations)
* **data/betting_history.db** — Parlay and settlement history

## 🧩 Copilot Behaviors

### Code Generation
* Always modular, documented, PEP8-compliant (Python)
* XML comments on all public methods (VB.NET/C#)
* Type hints and interfaces enforced
* Never hardcode API keys or secrets

### Predictive Analysis
* Compute `p_true` (model probability) vs `p_implied` (odds)
* Flag high-confidence EV bets (`EV > 5%`)
* Track calibration metrics (Brier, Log Loss)
* Recalibrate on model drift

### Bankroll Management
* Kelly or fractional Kelly stake sizing
* Max drawdown < 25%
* Sharpe ratio > 1.3
* Daily balance snapshots to database

### Revenue Tracking
* Sync all payment processors (Gumroad, sportsbooks, crypto)
* Update `revenue_snapshots` table hourly
* Generate monthly ROI and trend reports
* Visualize bankroll curves with drawdown overlays

### Business Intelligence
* Aggregate all 7 revenue streams in real-time
* Forecast next quarter using Prophet or similar
* Alert on anomalies or underperformance
* Recommend optimizations by stream

### CI/CD & Automation
* Build entire solution daily (`dotnet build EQ12.sln`)
* Run Python tests and bankroll validation
* Deploy models to Azure ML staging
* Push reports to GitHub Actions artifacts

## 📊 Advanced Metrics

| Metric      | Definition                      | Target   |
| ----------- | ------------------------------- | -------- |
| ROI         | (Final – Start) ÷ Staked        | > 10%    |
| Sharpe      | Mean Return ÷ Std Dev           | > 1.3    |
| Max DD      | Largest % drop from equity peak | < 25%    |
| Win Rate    | Wins ÷ Total Bets               | > 55%    |
| Brier Score | Calibration accuracy            | < 0.20   |
| Kelly       | Optimal stake allocation        | Dynamic  |

## 🔒 Safety & Compliance

* Default to **simulation mode** (paper trading only)
* Never auto-execute live bets without explicit approval
* Respect regional gambling regulations
* All financial data encrypted at rest
* API keys read from environment variables only
* Audit all transactions to database
